metadata.title: mymun Conference Date Extract (Cleaned)
metadata.effectiveFilters: Europe + Asia (`a=eu,as`), in-person only, future conferences, sort by price descending (`s=fe&r=desc`).
metadata.exportMethod: full filtered conference list API pull for review (9 pages at up to 50 rows per page, deduplicated by slug): `https://mymun.com/api/conferences?filter_time=future&sb=fe&order=desc&filter_cont=eu&filter_cont=as&online_conf=false&page={page}&per_page={perPage}`
metadata.note: The calendar view loads month-by-month and its calendar data request drops the sort params. This export pages through the full filtered conference list endpoint (the API caps each response at 50 rows, so multiple pages are fetched and deduplicated by conference slug) so all filtered conference date ranges are captured in one file. A source-side MUN relevance filter then keeps only entries whose slug, title, or name indicates a MUN or United Nations simulation.
cleaningRules: Removed entries marked as cancelled/canceled in the title.
Removed conferences with inclusive duration longer than 4 days.
Removed malformed records whose end date is earlier than the start date.
